events.title: 🔋 Beginner Soldering: Li-Ion Battery Pack
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description:
Make a rechargeable battery pack for your LoRa node, a microcontroller such as an ESP32 or Pi Pico, or anything that runs on 3–4 Volts. Perfect for folks who’ve never soldered before! 
To complete this project you’ll need to buy a li-ion battery pack kit for $3.99. Here’s what it includes: 
• 18650 battery clip w/ attached wires
• TP4056 charge controller board
• PH2.5 plug w/ attached wires
• 1/8″ heat shrink tubing (1.5″ long)
• 1/2″ heat shrink tubing (1″ long) 
You’ll also need a lithium-ion 18650 battery, available separately.

events.title: 🤔 FAFIO Beginner Tech Meetup
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: FAFIO is a meetup for folks who want to learn new tech skills, but aren’t sure where to start. Let’s fuck around and figure it out. FAFIO means there is no instructor. events.title: ☀ Milestone Mashup at Highmark Mann Center
events.venue: Highmark Mann Center, 5201 Parkside Ave, Philadelphia, PA, 19131, United States
events.description:
We’ll be tabling from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.! Stop by and build a solar-powered synthesizer, or learn to DJ with the open source program Mixxx. We’ll have books for sale too, and zines by donation! 
Taking place on Saturday, August 22, Highmark Mann’s Milestone Mashup is a free, campus-wide community event celebrating pivotal moments in our nation’s history that happened right here in Philadelphia. Designed as a journey through time, the event will bring these eras to life through a full day of engaging, family-friendly programming and activities.
